stories.title: Rücktritt Anfang 2027 – Seco-Direktorin Helene Budliger kündigt Rücktritt an

en.title: Resignation early 2027 – Seco Director Helene Budliger announces resignation
en.summary: State Secretary Helene Budliger Artieda will step down at the end of March 2027. A search commission will oversee the process of finding her successor.

stories.title: Die Stadt Zürich will die Zahl der Strassenbäume in Zürich verdoppeln – und das in horrendem Tempo

en.title: The city of Zurich wants to double the number of street trees in Zurich – and at a rapid pace
en.summary: Zurich plans to expand tree coverage so that a quarter of city streets will be shaded by tree canopies. The initiative focuses particularly on lower-income neighborhoods in Zurich-West.

stories.title: Après trente ans à Bulle, la pharma belge UCB continue d’investir en Suisse mais se tourne aussi davantage vers les Etats-Unis

en.title: After thirty years in Bulle, Belgian pharma UCB continues to invest in Switzerland but also increasingly turns towards the United States
en.summary: Belgian pharmaceutical company UCB celebrates 30 years of operations in Bulle, where it employs over 850 people at a major manufacturing site. The company announced a new investment exceeding 100 million francs in 2025 while simultaneously expanding its presence in the United States.

stories.title: Kosovo-Tribunal – Urteil gegen Hashim Thaci: Freiheitsheld und Kriegsverbrecher

en.title: Kosovo Tribunal – Verdict against Hashim Thaci: freedom fighter and war criminal
en.summary: Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaci has been sentenced to 25 years imprisonment for war crimes. The verdict raises questions regarding the Western world's role in these matters.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Gebäudeeinsturz in Gaza fordert zahlreiche zivile Opfer

en.title: War in the Middle East – Building collapse in Gaza claims numerous civilian casualties
en.summary: A damaged building collapsed in Gaza, killing at least 16 people. Many more are reported missing.

stories.title: Spätes Urteil in Den Haag: Kosovos früherer Präsident Hashim Thaci wegen Kriegsverbrechen verurteilt

en.title: Late verdict in The Hague: Kosovo's former President Hashim Thaci convicted of war crimes
en.summary: The Kosovo Special Tribunal convicted former President Hashim Thaci and three co-defendants to lengthy prison sentences. They are charged with responsibility for torture and killings of civilians during the Kosovo war.

stories.title: Die grossen US-Militärbasen im Nahen Osten sind untauglich: «Der amerikanische Schutzschirm wurde in diesem Krieg zerschmettert»

en.title: Major U.S. military bases in the Middle East are ineffective: "The American security umbrella has been shattered in this war"
en.summary: The United States cannot effectively protect its large military bases in the Middle East from Iranian missiles and drones. Damage amounts to billions of dollars and raises questions about America's protective role.

stories.title: Bundespräsident Parmelin verliert seine wichtigste Beamtin: Die Seco-Chefin Helene Budliger tritt ab

en.title: Federal President Parmelin loses his most important civil servant: Seco chief Helene Budliger steps down
en.summary: Helene Budliger, secretary of state at the economics ministry, is stepping down. She was known for handling sensitive tasks, including involvement in tariff negotiations.

stories.title: Le Kosovo vent debout contre la condamnation de son ancien président Hashim Thaçi pour crimes de guerre

en.title: Kosovo rises up against conviction of former president Hashim Thaçi for war crimes
en.summary: Hashim Thaçi was sentenced to 25 years in prison for war crimes against Serbian forces in the 1990s, sparking anger among Kosovars who view the verdict as a condemnation of their liberation struggle.

stories.title: Helene Budliger Artieda quitte la direction du Seco

en.title: Helene Budliger Artieda leaves position as head of Seco
en.summary: Helene Budliger Artieda, director of the State Secretariat for the Economy since 2022, announced her resignation effective end of March 2027 to the economy minister.

stories.title: Les Etats-Unis reconnaissent une pénurie de munitions après la guerre en Iran

en.title: United States acknowledges ammunition shortage following Iran conflict
en.summary: A defense department report acknowledged an ammunition shortage related to the Iran conflict, a situation the Trump administration had previously refused to confirm.

stories.title: L'ex-président du Kosovo Hashim Thaçi condamné à 25 ans de prison pour crimes de guerre

en.title: Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaçi sentenced to 25 years in prison for war crimes
en.summary: A special court for Kosovo based in The Hague convicted former president Hashim Thaçi of war crimes committed by the Kosovo Liberation Army against Serbian forces during the 1990s.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Russland will Europa spalten – deshalb ist ein europäischer Sicherheitsrat eine gute Idee

en.title: COMMENTARY - Russia wants to divide Europe – that's why a European security council is a good idea
en.summary: Ursula von der Leyen proposes rethinking EU security architecture amid NATO tensions. However, such consultations will lack impact without credible deterrence capabilities.

en.title: Federal President Parmelin loses his most important civil servant: Seco chief Helene Budliger steps down
en.summary: Helene Budliger, secretary of state at the economics ministry, is stepping down. She was known for handling sensitive tasks, including involvement in tariff negotiations.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Michael Kremer wird neuer Weltbank-Chefvolkswirt ++ Open AI erwägt laut Berichten neue Finanzierungsrunde vor Börsengang

en.title: BRIEF NEWS - Economy: Michael Kremer becomes new World Bank chief economist ++ Open AI reportedly considering new funding round before IPO
en.summary: Michael Kremer has been appointed as the World Bank's chief economist. OpenAI is reportedly exploring a new funding round prior to a potential public offering.

stories.title: Die OECD rüttelt am Schweizer Mietrecht

en.title: The OECD challenges Swiss rental law
en.summary: Switzerland faces worsening housing shortages. The OECD criticizes both slow housing construction and existing rent regulations, recommending reforms likely to spark political debate.

stories.title: Revolut will die Schweiz erobern: Was das für Kunden der Finanz-App und den Finanzplatz bedeutet

en.title: Revolut wants to conquer Switzerland: What this means for customers of the financial app and the financial center
en.summary: Europe's largest fintech company Revolut has applied for a banking license and is investing 150 million in expanding its Swiss operations.
